Etude Real Loose Powder – Oil Control & Smooth Matte Finish | Shades 21 & 22
Set your makeup to perfection with the Etude Real Loose Powder, crafted with care in Dubai. This finely milled, ultra-light powder offers a soft matte finish that controls shine and blurs imperfections — giving you that naturally flawless look all day.
 Key Features:• Lightweight, breathable formula• Minimizes pores and smooths skin texture• Long-lasting oil control without caking• Ideal for setting foundation or touch-ups
 Available Shades: Shade 21 – Light Beige: For fair skin tones with cool or neutral undertones Shade 22 – Natural Beige: For light to medium skin tones with warm or neutral undertones
Made in Dubai with high-quality ingredients, this loose powder is perfect for everyday wear — whether you're heading to work or going glam.
 Etude Real Loose Powder — Where modern beauty meets Middle Eastern excellence.
